text:
emma_cs: Morning team — quick sync on Sailfish private/VPC onboarding. High level: network peering staged, IAM roles missing for service account, KMS key rotation question, audit logs retention wants 1 year, and finance flagged a potential renewal risk if cutover slips. Need to align next steps.
ryan_se: hi — I can pick up the IAM role. which service account name are we using in the runbook?
emma_cs: svc-sailfish-infer in the runbook draft. Can you add least-privilege policies and tag it with the customer_id tag?
ryan_se: yep will add. also need to confirm we have the right STS trust from Sailfish cross-account. @tess_infra can you confirm peering route table assoc?
tess_infra: peering exists, but route propagation on the transit gateway to prod-subnets wasn't applied — doing that now. NAT config ok, but they want egress through our shared firewall cluster (AZ failover tested).
alejandro_sre: I'll run a smoke inference test once routes are done. please leave a placeholder 15-min window.
chloe_security: audit side: Sailfish requires immutable audit logs forwarded to their SIEM and retained 365 days. We need to confirm TLS+SSE for the log stream and that KMS key policy allows cross-account decrypt for their ops team. Also, GDPR retention note: retention overrides must be documented.
emma_cs: good catch. can we confirm encryption details? @kms-bot any key policy summary?
kms-bot: Key KMS-sailfish-001: rotation_enabled=true, key_policy_principals=[redwood-platform, sailfish-ops:arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/SailfishOps], cross-account-decrypt=allowed, next_rotation=2026-06-10.
chloe_security: that looks fine but we need explicit principal for the SIEM ingest lambda. ask them for the lambda role ARN or we default to a bucket-level access grant.
ryan_se: adding IAM role and lambda role placeholder to runbook now: svc-sailfish-infer-role, sailfish-siem-lambda-role. tagging done.
tess_infra: routes propagated. peering status: ACTIVE. firewall rules: need inbound 1024-65535 ephemeral for return traffic + allow 443 to our model API endpoints. I'll paste the small rule snippet in the runbook.
emma_cs: FYI finance ping: renewal signal if cutover > 3 weeks from original cut date. we should aim to hit cutover next Tues. if not, I need to flag to AMs.
alejandro_sre: can we schedule the 15-min smoke at Tues 10:15 PT? prefer earlier but works.
emma_cs: scheduled. ACTIONS: ryan add IAM roles + lambda ARN by EOD, tess confirm firewall snippet in runbook, alejandro run smoke Tues 10:15 PT, chloe confirm SIEM principal or choose bucket grant, emma will escalate renewal if we miss Tues.
ryan_se: done — IAM policy commit pushed to the runbook branch: https://rbw.internal/sailfish/runbook/compare (PR: add-iam-roles).
tess_infra: firewall snippet added to runbook under Networking -> Firewall. snippet:
```
- allow: src=0.0.0.0/0 dst=10.2.4.0/24 proto=tcp ports=443
- allow: src=10.2.0.0/16 dst=10.2.4.0/24 proto=tcp ports=1024-65535 (ephemeral)
```
chloe_security: holding on SIEM principal until Sailfish provides the lambda role ARN. I sent a quick ask to their onboarding channel.
deploy-bot: [staging-deploy] model-serving-stack: successful deploy to staging (build 2026.5.18-042) — logs: https://rbw.ci/staging/2026.5.18-042
alejandro_sre: will validate staging after deploy and confirm smoke pass/fail in this thread.
emma_cs: thanks everyone. capture any post-smoke findings here and I'll update the customer health doc. please flag any blockers ASAP — I want to avoid the renewal escalation. :pray:
